user.title: Connect to MeshMonitor
user.description: Enter the local MeshMonitor URL and a read-only API token.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to MeshMonitor
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a replacement read-only API token.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure MeshMonitor
reconfigure.description: Update the exact server URL or API token. Leave the token blank to keep the current token. Every visible supported source is validated before the server entry is changed.

error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS base URL without credentials, a query string, or a fragment.
error.insufficient_permissions: The token cannot read the required source endpoints.
error.no_supported_sources: No visible Meshtastic, MeshCore, or Reticulum source was found.
error.node_visibility_required: The source is visible but its node list is empty. Enable View on map for an allowed channel in MeshMonitor.
error.source_not_found: The configured source does not exist or is not visible at this server.

abort.already_configured: This MeshMonitor server is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Unable to validate the selected source.
abort.insufficient_permissions: The token cannot read node data for this source.
abort.node_visibility_required: A source is visible but its node list is empty. Enable View on map for an allowed channel in MeshMonitor.
abort.legacy_entry_unsupported: This pre-v1 source entry cannot be converted safely. Remove it and add the MeshMonitor server again after installing the completed redesign.

server_settings.title: Server settings
server_settings.description: Choose the settings shared by all sources on this MeshMonitor server.

data.enable_automation_visibility: Read configured automations and recent outcomes (requires global automations:read)
data.node_device_policy: Home Assistant devices (all nodes remain visible in the MeshMonitor panel)

confirm_registry_cleanup.title: Confirm Home Assistant device cleanup
confirm_registry_cleanup.description: This narrower policy will remove {devices} node devices and {entities} entities from Home Assistant. All nodes and history remain unchanged in MeshMonitor and visible in the panel.

data.confirm_registry_cleanup: Remove these Home Assistant devices and entities

source_settings.title: Source settings
source_settings.description: Configure polling, exposure, privacy, and explicit write gates only for the selected source.

data.enable_device_trackers: Expose positioned nodes to the Home Assistant map
data.enable_message_polling: Poll message history and enable the Messages view/events
data.expose_message_text: Include message text in Home Assistant events
data.enable_favorites: Allow server-persistent favorites (requires nodes:write; never syncs Meshtastic favorites to the radio)
data.enable_transmit: Enable outbound messages for this source
data.enable_node_management: Allow automation actions to favorite or ignore nodes (server-only; never syncs Meshtastic state to the radio)
data.automated_tx_utilization_limit: Pause automated transmissions at or above channel utilization (%) — 0 disables
data.enable_node_removal: Allow removing remote Meshtastic nodes and stored history from MeshMonitor (requires messages:write)

refresh_source_inventory.title: Refresh source inventory
refresh_source_inventory.description: Confirm the validated inventory update. New sources: {added}. Recreated sources recognized and replaced: {replaced}. Temporarily absent sources retained: {retained}. Total stored sources: {total}.

error.insufficient_permissions: The token cannot read the required source endpoints.
error.no_supported_sources: No visible Meshtastic, MeshCore, or Reticulum source was found.
error.node_visibility_required: A source is visible but its node list is empty. Enable View on map for an allowed channel in MeshMonitor.
error.registry_cleanup_confirmation_required: Confirm the Home Assistant registry cleanup to continue.

abort.legacy_entry_unsupported: This pre-v1 source entry cannot be configured. Remove it and add the MeshMonitor server again after installing the completed redesign.

send_direct_message.name: Send direct message to a custom recipient
send_direct_message.description: Send one message using an exact recipient name or protocol ID, or an existing Home Assistant node device. For a live source-specific node dropdown, use the Device action named Send direct message to a known node. This performs a radio transmission and is never retried automatically.

source_device_id.name: Source device
source_device_id.description: The local MeshMonitor radio source that will transmit the message.

destination_device_id.name: Known destination node
destination_device_id.description: One Home Assistant node device belonging to the selected source. Use either this field or Recipient ID or exact name.

recipient.name: Recipient ID or exact name
recipient.description: Alternative to Known destination node. Enter an exact known name, a Meshtastic node ID (! followed by 8 hexadecimal digits), a 64-digit MeshCore public key, or a 32-digit Reticulum destination hash.

text.name: Message
text.description: Text to send. Protocol-specific length limits are validated before transmission.

reply_id.name: Reply to message ID (optional)
reply_id.description: Meshtastic only. Use the triggering message ID to preserve reply linkage.

send_channel_message.name: Send channel message
send_channel_message.description: Send one message to one channel through a selected MeshMonitor source. This performs a radio transmission and is never retried automatically.

source_device_id.name: Source device
source_device_id.description: The local MeshMonitor radio source that will transmit the message.

channel.name: Channel index
channel.description: Meshtastic channels use 0–7; MeshCore channels use 0–255.

text.name: Message
text.description: Text to send. Protocol-specific length limits are validated before transmission.

send_advert.name: Send MeshCore advert
send_advert.description: Send one MeshCore flood advert from the selected source. This action is limited to once every five minutes and is never retried automatically.

source_device_id.name: Source device
source_device_id.description: The local MeshCore source that will transmit the advert.

action_type.send_channel_message_to_known_channel: Send channel message to a known channel
action_type.request_traceroute_from_known_node: Request a traceroute from a known node

action_type.request_node_info_from_known_node: Request node information from a known node
action_type.request_neighbors_from_known_node: Request neighbor information from a known node
action_type.favorite_known_node: Add a known node to favorites
action_type.unfavorite_known_node: Remove a known node from favorites
action_type.ignore_known_node: Ignore a known node in MeshMonitor
action_type.unignore_known_node: Stop ignoring a known node in MeshMonitor

trigger_type.direct_message_received: A direct mesh message is received
trigger_type.channel_message_received: A channel mesh message is received
trigger_type.node_discovered: A new mesh node is discovered
